note: The twelve numeric multi-session failures of the adopted arm `45543010618` (500 questions, two repetitions, `layered` + `verbatim-acts`), named by `docs/AUDIT-NUMERIC-MEMBERSHIP.md` 1. This file exists because `--artifact` selects the failing set of the report it is handed, and the report this arm's ceiling has to be read against is not a report -- it is a written audit of twelve replies, read one by one in the reader's own words. The arithmetic below is that audit's table, repeated here so a run prints its bar beside its reading instead of referring to a document that may have moved. Frozen before the dispatch it prices; an id added after a reading exists would be a population chosen by its result.

source.corpus: longmemeval_s_cleaned.json, rebuilt from every haystack session -- the whole history, not the arm window, so both ceilings are upper bounds on what a windowed pass could reach

groups.name: membership-dropped
groups.what: a member the gold keeps was dropped by an invented evidentiary bar, an over-merge or an over-strict period; six of the twelve, and the institution `docs/AUDIT-NUMERIC-MEMBERSHIP.md` 3 says the next mechanism has to be

groups.name: membership-kept
groups.what: a member the gold drops was kept: one object stated twice, one replacement counted as two rows, a boundary the question states in words, and an amount the event raised rather than the user

groups.name: not-membership
groups.what: the two the audit excludes from the membership institution: a stated value picked wrongly, and a derived value that needs a second fact the history never states
